source.title: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 v1, 60 arc-second ice surface

files.encoding: int16 little-endian, signed metres above EGM2008 geoid; negative bathymetry
files.resampling: bilinear pixel-centre sampling, rounded to nearest metre

source.title: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 v1, 15 arc-second ice surface tiles

files.encoding: int16 little-endian, signed metres above EGM2008 geoid; negative bathymetry
files.resampling: none: native source pixels, rounded to nearest metre
files.convention: rows north to south; pixel centre longitude west + (x + 0.5) / 240, latitude north - (y + 0.5) / 240
files.use: Regional detail for Florida. Loaded after height.i16 into one buffer; sampled inside the bounds and blended into the global grid over its outer margin.

convention.unitVector: x=cos(lat)*cos(lon), y=cos(lat)*sin(lon), z=sin(lat); angles in radians (sim/terrain/geo.ts latLonToUnit)
convention.sampling: wrap longitude; bilinear float64; outer half-row blends to the mean polar row at each pole

limits: Approx. 9.8 km equatorial spacing (Florida: ~460 m, see height-cape.i16). Narrow islands, coastlines, summits and trenches are smoothed. Ice surface, not bedrock. Climate/cover classes are approximate geographic rules, not measured land cover. The flattened launch-complex footprint is an explicit gameplay override.
